note: Eight stages in the order the game lets you play them. Stages 0 and 7 run underneath everything else: start the long counters on day one, and expect the last stage to be the longest.

stages.g: There is no mission replay and no New Game+, so keep a manual save at the start of every chapter and one before the final mission — you have 15 manual slots plus the autosave. Never turn cheats on: they disable trophies and saving. Every long-haul counter on this stage can start in the first hour.

Play Chapter 1, and before its final mission meditate at Lucia's balcony spot — it counts toward Positive Mental Attitude and disappears forever when the chapter ends. It is the only truly missable thing in the game.
stages.n: Chapter 1 — Paradise, and the one missable

stages.g: Jason and Lucia both become playable, switching on the partner trophies. Daily Driver unlocks the garage market and Moses opens the Scooter Bros app — buy garages and register vehicles as the money arrives.

The Race Against Yago strand appears and is time-sensitive: run it the moment it shows. Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs gives you the Snap Gun, the key to Sneakthief. Take a fresh manual save at the chapter start.

Near the end of Chapter 4, clear the optional mission That's Where The Money Is to unlock the bank vaults. From here the money trophies open up: rob vaults and push marked bills through your laundering contacts.
Close out the stranger strands — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and Bret's hunt. None of them expire; every finale stays available after the credits.

Finish the story (manual save before the final mission), then sweep what the open world still owes: drone races, card sets, the VCIA jet, the Mile Zero tanks, gang operations and the odd little moment trophies. The 100% checklist is now visible under Progress > Stats.
What is left is arithmetic: 250 stunts (300 for the checklist), 42 range golds, 50 challenges on the way to 70 of 80, and the 100% line itself. When A Long Road pops, the Platinum follows.

title: Roadmap to the Platinum
